summary: Added three ECS rules: E3052 (Fargate task definitions must use NetworkMode awsvpc), E3053 (Fargate services must set NetworkConfiguration), and E3054 (Fargate task definitions must set ExecutionRoleArn). Each has a schema JSON, a rule module under src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, a unit test file, and a docs/rules.md row. The ECS and rules-collection tests pass (86 passed) with PYTHONPATH=src. The venv imports a separate base/ checkout, so I used PYTHONPATH=src to test this repo's code. Full unit suite: 1528 passed, with two environment-only failures (test_formatters.py needs defusedxml, excluded; test_build_graph needs pygraphviz/pydot). Nothing committed. E3054 is the least certain choice, since AWS doesn't require an execution role for every Fargate task.
